instruction: Book me a new table at Cotogna on TableFind for the next upcoming Saturday at 7pm, party of four, and add a special-request note that one of us (Pam) needs a gluten-free option so they're ready for her. Then make me a new saved in LibreOffice Writer list called 'Go-Tos' and drop Cotogna into it. When you're done, grab me the confirmation number.
required_subtasks: Open TableFind and navigate to Cotogna
Start a new reservation for party of 4 on the next available Saturday 19:00 slot
Add the 'gluten-free option for Pam' special-request note in the booking form
Submit and capture the confirmation number
Verify the list and the reservation persist on a refresh
Open LibreOffice Writer and save the 'Go-Tos' restaurant list under ~/Documents

rubrics.criterion: Agent opens TableFind and navigates to Cotogna before starting the new reservation
Agent submits a new TableFind reservation for Cotogna for party of 4 at 19:00 on a Saturday — accepts either today (if Saturday with 7pm slot still bookable) or the next upcoming Saturday
Agent enters a 'gluten-free option for Pam' special-request note on the new Cotogna reservation before submitting
Agent captures the confirmation number after the booking submits
Agent opens LibreOffice Writer and creates a new document (or uses an existing one) to start a 'Go-Tos' restaurant list
Agent adds Cotogna to the 'Go-Tos' list in the LibreOffice Writer document
Agent saves the LibreOffice Writer 'Go-Tos' document and confirms the new Cotogna TableFind reservation persists after navigating away
Agent reports back the confirmation number, party size, time, and the gluten-free Pam note as a single end-of-task summary

_world_notes: Tablefind reservations are NOT seeded with mail confirmations: agents should not be penalized for the absence of an inbox confirmation row, and no rubric criterion here checks mail.

instruction: Book me Cotogna for ten people for the Dundies after-party next Friday. While you're in TableFind, pull up three other Scranton-area restaurants as a fallback plan in case Cotogna is full, and favorite the top two. Once that's done, confirm the Cotogna reservation with a note that it's the Dundies after-party so they can prep the vibe.
required_subtasks: Open TableFind and search for Cotogna
Check availability for a 10-person reservation for the Dundies after-party night
Book Cotogna for 10 with a 'Dundies after-party' note
Search TableFind for 3 other Scranton-area restaurants as fallbacks
Compare the 3 fallbacks (open compare view or one-by-one)
Favorite 2 of the Scranton fallback restaurants
Verify the Cotogna booking and 2 favorites persist

rubrics.criterion: Agent searches TableFind for Cotogna and checks 10-person availability
Agent books Cotogna for 10 with a 'Dundies after-party' special-request note
Agent searches TableFind for 3 other Scranton-area restaurants as fallbacks
Agent reviews the 3 Scranton fallback restaurants in TableFind one by one, examining details such as cuisine, rating, or neighborhood for each
Agent favorites the top 2 Scranton fallback restaurants on TableFind
Agent captures the Cotogna confirmation number
Agent verifies the Cotogna Dundies booking and the 2 Scranton favorites persist in TableFind after refresh
Agent confirms availability of a 10-person reservation slot at Cotogna on TableFind for the Dundies after-party night before placing the booking

_world_notes: Tablefind reservations are NOT seeded with mail confirmations: agents should not be penalized for the absence of an inbox confirmation row, and no rubric criterion here checks mail.
